rulings.why: The main refrain rows print 'Beau-ti-ful, beau-ti-ful Zi-on; We're march-ing up-ward to'; 'heaven-ly' is from the men's answering row 'heaven-ly Zi-on,' under refrain system 2, which the reading took instead.
Refrain system 2's main row prints 'The beau-ti-ful cit-y of God.'; the men's answering row under it stops at 'heaven-ly Zi-on,', so the reading that took that row has nothing here.

rulings.why: p407-strip1600.jpg system 5, row 2: 'heaven-ly Zi-on,' is printed under the middle of the system only, unnumbered, beneath row 1's 'Zi - on,', where the bass staff moves while the treble holds 'Zi-'. Row 1 is a whole line without it, so it is a part for the lower voices, as is the half row under system 4.
settles: 422 shape (shape-13): a row "heavenly zion" (second refrain row under the treble staff, no mark, printed under the middle of the system only: other words for part of the refrain, likely for other voices) is in no part of the printed source
